# Nordic Skater

> > Specialty retailer for Nordic skating, cross-country skiing, and roller skiing equipment featuring brands like Zandstra, Salomon, Rossignol, and Rottefella binding systems.

Nordic Skater is operated by AJ Parks in Newbury, NH near Lake Sunapee, offering expert consultation, equipment sales, and rental programs for Nordic ice skates, skate skis, and roller skis. The store specializes in NIS and NNN binding systems with Turnamic and Prolink compatibility.

## Key Topics

- Nordic skating and ice skates
- Cross-country skate skiing
- Roller skis and training equipment
- Zandstra Nordic skates and blades
- NIS (Nordic Integrated System) bindings
- NNN (New Nordic Norm) bindings
- Turnamic and Prolink systems
- Rottefella binding technology
- Salomon and Rossignol skis
- Skate vs classic ski techniques
- Equipment rentals and rent-to-own
- Boot fitting and sizing guides
- Ice safety for winter skating
- Pole lengtheners and accessories

## Getting Started

- [Nordic Skater | XC Skis, Roller Skis, Ice Skates](https://nordicskater.com): Homepage featuring Nordic skates, skate skis, and roller skis from brands
- [About Nordic Skater](https://nordicskater.com/pages/about): Owner AJ Parks bio and store location in Newbury, NH near Lake Sunapee
- [Collections](https://nordicskater.com/collections): Product catalog with 199 items across apparel, boots, and bindings
- [FAQ](https://nordicskater.com/pages/faq): Shipping, returns, team pricing, wholesale, and rental policies

## Nordic Ice Skating

- [Nordic Ice Skates](https://nordicskater.com/pages/nordic-skates): Guide to Nordic skating basics, blade types, and brands like Zandstra
- [Nordic Skate Rental](https://nordicskater.com/products/nordic-skate-rental): Nordic ice skate rentals by day, week, or season
- [Zandstra NIS Nordic Skate Bare](https://nordicskater.com/products/zandstra-nis-ice-blades-bare-1750): Zandstra NIS platform ice blades with Rockwell 60 steel, binding sold sep
- [Ice Safety Tips!](https://nordicskater.com/pages/ice-safety-tips): Ice safety tips for preventing hypothermia and winter skating hazards

## Cross-Country Skiing

- [Cross Country Ski Types](https://nordicskater.com/pages/cross-country-ski-types): Guide to skate, classic track, and light touring ski differences
- [Boot Buying Guide](https://nordicskater.com/pages/boot-buying-guide): Guide for selecting classic, skate, combi, and rollerski boots with NNN/NIS
- [Size Chart - Ski, Pole and Boots](https://nordicskater.com/pages/size-chart-ski-pole): Sizing guide for skate, classic, and combi skis plus pole lengths
- [Salomon S/Max Skate Ski w/Shift-in Prolink Bindings](https://nordicskater.com/products/salomon-s-max-skate-ski-w-shift-in-prolink-bindings): Salomon S/Max carbon skate ski with Prolink bindings for racing
- [Rossignol Race Skate Turnamic Binding](https://nordicskater.com/products/rossignol-race-skate-turnamic-binding): Turnamic race binding compatible with NNN/Prolink boots, tool-free adjust

## Roller Skiing

- [Roller Ski Rental](https://nordicskater.com/pages/roller-ski-rental): 2-week roller ski rentals for V2, Swenor, Swix, Rundle, SnowWing models
- [Rental Roller Skis](https://nordicskater.com/pages/rental-roller-skis): Rent-to-own program for roller skis with expert consultation

## Optional

- [Pole Lengtheners](https://nordicskater.com/products/pole-lengtheners): Carbon fiber pole extenders from Sweden adding up to 3" length
- [Kitewing 3.0 Sport](https://nordicskater.com/products/kitewing-3-0-sport-1546): Handheld wing sail for ice skating and roller blading with Dacron/mylar
